rules: Italic serif on the emotional word.
All-caps eyebrows only. Nothing else is uppercase except buttons and nav.
CTAs are verbs: BOOK, READ, JOIN, SHOP, VISIT.
No exclamation marks in body copy.
First person 'I' on About. 'Amber's Essential Touch' elsewhere. Never 'we'.
No medical claims — supports, calms, softens. Never cures, treats, heals.
Close every page on touch, held, carry, care, or seen.
voice.luxuryRule: AET rejects luxury-as-price, embraces luxury-as-quality. Never call the service a luxury. You may call the ingredients luxurious.

photography.canonical: Light system — warm ivory, blush, dusty rose, botanical green. Amber's real portraits. Naturally lit, calm, intimate.
photography.editorialOnly: Dark baroque — black, oxblood, plum, reflective metals. Seasonal campaign layer only. Must not govern the site.
photography.founderRule: Any regeneration must preserve Amber's real face, natural proportions, and loc colour and style. Never substitute an AI person for Amber.

rights.note: ref.png and all Firefly/Gemini output need commercial-rights confirmation before external publication.

logo.recommendation: Simplified mark for digital (header, favicon, social); original illustrative mark retained for print and signage where the hand can be seen.
